title: Pairing token
description: GET poll once the user approved on the server's side (SPEC.md § 5.2). Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> (§ 5.1).

token.description: Opaque, 128 bits of entropy at least.

expires.description: Seconds until the token expires; absent, it lasts until revoked.

bound.description: Whether the token is bound to the key sent at pairing (SPEC.md § 5.4).
